style: Use: header illustration for a class card in a community-center attendance app. Medium: hand-painted gouache on textured paper, storybook illustration, visible brush strokes and soft paper grain. Composition: wide landscape scene, main subject centered with generous empty margins at top and bottom (the image will be cropped to a 16:10 band). Palette limited to deep flag blue (#1847a8), warm sand and Jerusalem-stone beige, one brick-red accent (#b5391d) and cream highlights; gentle warm daylight from the left; light airy background. Simple, confident shapes. Constraints: no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos; people are stylized, faceless or seen from a distance, no realistic faces.
